steps: Preheat the oven to 220 C (425 F) and let the salmon sit out while it heats.

Halve the cherry tomatoes and olives, thinly slice the red onion and lemon, and mince the garlic. Put them all in a 23 x 33 cm baking dish with 1 tbsp olive oil, 1/4 tsp salt and a grind of black pepper, and toss to coat.
Pat the salmon dry, rub it with the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil and 1 tsp salt, and set the fillets on top of the vegetables.
Mix the smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder and cumin, and sprinkle evenly over the fillets. Scatter the capers on top.
Bake 15-20 minutes, until the salmon flakes easily and reaches about 54 C (130 F) internally.
Garnish with fresh parsley or dill and serve, spooning the roasted tomatoes and pan juices over each portion.
